document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You hear something stir behind you, like an eruption in the 
snow. You  turn  and  catch  a  flash  of  a  one-eyed,  wheel-like, 
revolving entity following you. It pauses at the top of the rise.
